propositions: Read-only Git probes in repo-isolation hooks run without subprocess timeout, allowing blocked child processes to keep pytest alive indefinitely after test completion.
The autouse fixture _no_repo_commits and pytest_sessionfinish hook both invoke head() and porcelain() synchronously with no upper bound, exposing real checkout guards to unbounded waits.
Test monkeypatches of the shared subprocess module's run attribute contaminate autouse teardown because the guard dereferences that mutable reference before pytest restores it.

The fix binds the real subprocess.run at module import and adds an explicit 5-second timeout to both head() and porcelain() probes, re-raising TimeoutExpired while preserving None for ordinary failures.
Timeout failures must be distinguished and surfaced as explicit isolation-infrastructure failures rather than silently swallowed as None to enforce the guard contract.
